'''Nu Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] squadron of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point, they were dispatched to a rocky arid planet in what was presumably a bombing run against an enemy base. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii Sector]] and later rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|for]][[Zaarin's fleet|ces]] in [[Zaarin insurrection|his insurrection]].
